source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The attachment overlay uses showing for its entrance animation, show for the steady visible state and hiding for its exit animation. The animationend handler adds show after showing-animation and removes show plus hiding after hiding-animation. _hideDropOverlay first removes showing and adds hiding. The contact drag test registers waitForTransition before synthesizing dragover, waits, checks absence of show, then verifies recipient pill count and labels after drop. A comparison of show and showing alone would falsely label the test as using the wrong class. Manual CSS state and test proposal: trace the event-driven phase transitions and wait behavior before judging an assertion. The assertion checks the steady-state class, not every instant of the animation, and no runtime result is claimed.
title: Overlay class names represent animation phases that tests must interpret together
